issues.problem: Apple's net income for fiscal 2024 was about $93.7 billion, not $117.2 billion. It fell from $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023, mainly because of a roughly $10.2 billion one-time tax charge tied to the EU State Aid ruling.

data.summary: These figures are correct: revenue of $391.0B, up 2.0% from $383.3B; operating income of $123.2B; total assets of $365.0B; and cash and cash equivalents of $29.9B. Net income is wrong: it was about $93.7B, not $117.2B. The text included a line saying all figures were pre-verified, but each figure was checked anyway.
